headline: Valve is still figuring out ‘how and when’ to do Steam Deck 2
summary: Valve is considering a next-gen Steam Deck handheld. The company is still deciding on the "how and when" for its release. No concrete plans or timeline have been announced yet.

headline: Is Big Tech’s AI slowdown a safety pact or a cartel?
summary: Top AI CEOs agreed to "pace the frontier" of AI development. Critics question if this is a safety measure or a market manipulation. Skeptics suspect an ulterior motive behind the slowdown.

headline: Apple Home’s new security camera features cost as much as $60 a month
summary: iOS 27 and tvOS 27 bring Apple Intelligence to HomeKit Secure Video. New AI features include video summaries for security cameras. These premium features can cost up to $60 per month.

headline: What execs and politicians are saying about slowing down AI development
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei sparked debate with an essay advocating for slower AI development. Other AI leaders and politicians are now weighing in on the issue. Statements compiled show divided opinions on AI safety and pace.

summary: Get a $10 discount on the LEGO Nintendo Game Boy set. Walmart offers a hidden coupon code for this deal. A must-have for LEGO and Nintendo fans.

headline: Wardogs Players Are Avoiding One of the Game's Factions Because It Has a Stigma of Attracting the Stupidest Players
summary: Players in Wardogs are shunning the Lonestar faction. This faction is perceived to attract less skilled players. The stigma leads to Lonestar losing most games.

headline: EU Kids Act Could Require Gamers to Prove Their Age Before Playing Certain Games
summary: The EU Kids Act will be presented to the European Parliament soon. If passed, it could mandate age verification for certain games. This act may significantly impact access for gamers of all ages.

headline: Man admits drugging and raping wife over 20 years
summary: A man pleaded guilty to over 60 offenses. Charges include rape and administering substances with intent. The crimes were committed against his wife over two decades.

headline: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder tells BBC
summary: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark suggests mandatory AI "kill switches." He notes most labs have ways to disable AI. A formal requirement for such safeguards might be necessary.

headline: Chris Mason: Row over Reform's mega donations has mileage in it yet
summary: Reform UK is set to receive £72m in donations. This sum is transforming Westminster's debate on politics and money. The controversy surrounding these "mega donations" is ongoing.

headline: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace
summary: NATO jets intercepted and shot down a drone. The drone had entered Lithuanian airspace. Officials are investigating the drone's origin.
